newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shun Shing wins HK hospital contract.
newsitem.headline: Shun Shing wins HK hospital contract.

text.p: Shun Shing Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday it won a HK$267 million contract to build a new multi-services complex at the Yan Chai Hosiptal in Hong Kong.
The contract covers the construction of a 13-storey reinforced concrete structure with all finishes and fitting out as well as all building services installation.
The contract would boost the company's contracts-in-hand to HK$3.20 billion. Outstanding value of uncompleted works is around HK$1.87 billion, the company said in the statement.
